data.title: Rental agreement, Beispielweg 5 (Wohnbau Musterstadt eG)
data.summary: Rental contract with Wohnbau Musterstadt eG for a 48.6 m² flat at Beispielweg 5, signed 15 September 2025, starting 1 October 2025 with no fixed end. Total monthly rent is €640.00, due by the third working day of each month.
data.explanation: This is your signed tenancy agreement (Mietvertrag). It runs indefinitely. You pay €640.00 each month (base rent plus service charge and heating prepayments), and the money must be in the landlord's account by the third working day of the month. You may cancel in writing; the notice must reach the landlord by the third working day of a month to end the tenancy at the end of the month after next. The deposit of €1,560.00 can be paid in three equal instalments. Keep this contract safe.

contract.name: Rental agreement Beispielweg 5
quotes: Das Mietverhältnis beginnt am 01.10.2025 und läuft auf unbestimmte Zeit.
Der Mieter kann das Mietverhältnis spätestens am dritten Werktag eines Kalendermonats zum Ablauf des übernächsten Monats kündigen (§ 573c Abs. 1 BGB).
